raw_blocks: Building and Maintaining Trusted Infrastructure Across North America
See How Centuri Powers North America’s Critical Energy Infrastructure
Learn More About Our Capabilities

Every time a light switches on, a hospital meter hums, or an electric vehicle (EV) charger powers up, a vast network of energy infrastructure is quietly at work. Between 2024 and 2033, U.S. annual energy use will grow by 6,000 to 10,000 terawatt hours (TWh), requiring $1.886 trillion in energy investments. Centuri answers that challenge with its energy and utility infrastructure solutions needed to modernize, expand, and harden networks. We partner with regulated utilities and energy providers to deliver infrastructure projects—whether electric transmission and distribution, natural gas pipelines, battery energy storage systems (BESS), or underground fiber—exactly where they are needed. Together as a unified team of 9,600 professionals managing more than 13,000 fleet assets, we mobilize quickly across the U.S. and Canada, delivering projects that keep power and gas flowing regardless of geography and complexity.

Centuri delivers services through our operating companies working together to put the energy infrastructure in place that will power the lives of generations to come. Our values and commitments to our employees, the communities where we work, and the world we share distinguish us among our peers as a leader in building a more sustainable future.
Centuri is a North American leader in building sustainable infrastructure . Supported by our values and commitments to our communities, we stand out from our competitors in several ways:
Client-focused, long-term partner: Centuri provides high quality services as a trusted partner to our customers, with long-standing relationships averaging 24 years.

Safety woven into every job: Our Total Recordable Incident Rate (TRIR) and Days Away, Restricted, or Transferred (DART) rates outperform industry averages year after year, aided by rigorous crew training and safety management systems.

Local Service, Resources to scale: With 9,600 employees and hundreds of crews across 99 locations, we offer a full range of infrastructure services backed by a scaled organization that affords agile, local service delivery.

Commitment to sustainable energy solutions: Centuri is at the forefront of building a sustainable energy future. Whether laying high-density polyethylene (HDPE) pipes for Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) projects or installing battery storage systems, we are an essential partner in your alternative energy projects.

“Investments in the power grid are the backbone of our nation’s economy,” notes Maria Robinson, former Director of the U.S. DOE Grid Deployment Office (GDO, 2024). Regulated utilities, pipeline operators, and clean energy developers must deliver uninterrupted service during every load spike and weather event. Centuri is the partner that turns that mandate into measurable reliability. From 500 kV transmission spans engineered to ride out 140-mph winds to gas mains directionally drilled beneath dense urban corridors, we bridge the last-mile gap so your network delivers.

Tomorrow’s demand curve will be steeper and less predictable. Data centers alone could draw nearly 9 percent of U.S. electricity by 2030 (EPRI, 2024), even as decarbonization targets accelerate the growth of distributed generation. Centuri helps you stay ahead of that complexity. We integrate conventional power with battery storage and renewable natural gas. Our microgrids experts deliver turnkey projects safely and on budget. Whether you’re hardening circuits, upgrading compressor stations for renewable blends, or fast-tracking a 100 MWh BESS to monetize peak-shaving, our team mobilizes quickly and executes with the precision your stakeholders expect.
Electric Infrastructure – Transmission line construction up to 500 kV, overhead and underground distribution, substation EPC, cable replacement, and energized (live-line) maintenance.

Natural Gas Infrastructure – End-to-end solutions from transmission to neighborhood distribution, including pipeline fabrication, directional drilling, internal camera inspections, cathodic-protection upgrades, cross compression, compressor stations, and regulator overhauls.

Distributed Power & Data Centers – Civil and electrical scopes for solar, battery-energy-storage systems (BESS), renewable natural gas (RNG) injection, and EV infrastructure that deliver clean energy capacity faster with lower emissions, plus data center capabilities.
Underground Infrastructure – Design-build of fiber, broadband, water, and power conduits that increase resiliency and unlock smart-city connectivity while minimizing surface disruption.

Emergency Response & Storm Restoration – A continent-wide emergency-response network with pre-positioned materials and rapid-deployment crews that cut outage durations when storms strike. We offer post-construction site restoration, including complete civil restoration, vegetation management, and habitat protection, turning projects into long-term sustainable infrastructure assets.
We Care About Our People and Communities

We succeed only when we leave communities stronger than we found them. At Centuri, we care for the people and communities we work with. We build sustainable local economies by hiring local union and non-union personnel and sourcing from a diverse pool of suppliers. In our operations, safety is more than a metric; it is Centuri’s culture. Regular safety audits, our behavior-based program, and crew training ensure that our employees work safely every day.

We are committed to safeguarding the environment in our work. We give back to the communities we serve. We contribute to causes that matter to our customers and our communities. Recognizing the importance of building for the future, we inspire future generations through scholarship programs and apprenticeships that prepare the next generation workforce.

We also support a speak-up culture through our EthicsPoint Helpline. Employees, customers, and community members can report concerns through the Centuri Ethics Helpline (1-855-722-2816) and centuri.ethicspoint.com (opens in a new tab) .
Connecting People to Possibility: Careers in Energy Infrastructure

At Centuri, our work keeps lights on, homes warm, and communities connected—today and for the cleaner energy future we’re building. Join a team where safety is non-negotiable, innovation is encouraged, and every role contributes to North America’s resilient gas, electric, and renewable energy infrastructure. We invest in you through world-class craft and leadership training, industry-leading benefits, and clear career pathways that move as boldly as our projects. Whether you’re stepping onto the jobsite, designing next-generation systems, or supporting operations, you’ll be empowered to grow, give back, and take pride in a career that truly makes an impact every day.

We don’t just build energy networks; we build futures. As North America’s leader in sustainable utility infrastructure services, Centuri offers more than jobs. We offer a clear path to personal growth. From apprentice lineman to project management, discover how our commitment to training creates limitless opportunities for advancement.
Dedicated Teams Powering the Future

From journeyman line workers braving every season to underground crews maintaining safe utility lines, Centuri’s people are the heart of our success. Our 9,600-plus professionals unite deep craft expertise with a shared commitment to safety, innovation, and community stewardship. Field crews collaborate seamlessly with project managers, environmental specialists, and data analysts to deliver resilient gas, electric, and renewable infrastructure that millions depend on daily. Guided by values-driven leadership and supported by continuous training, our team embraces new technologies to build smarter, safer systems. When you partner with Centuri, you gain a passionate workforce dedicated to powering progress for customers, communities, and a cleaner energy future.
Get in Touch and Start Building the Future with Us

Whether you’re planning a 100-mile gas transmission loop, strengthening coastal transmission lines against hurricanes, or strategizing the next phase of your clean energy roadmap, Centuri is ready. Our pre-construction teams can help with job designs, permitting, and right-of-way acquisition. Contact us today for a discovery session to align scope, schedule, and stakeholder goals—because building sustainable infrastructure is not just our business but our responsibility.
How do we start a project?

Everything begins with a collaborative scoping conversation. During the Request for Proposal (RFP) or early planning phase, we review technical requirements, safety and environmental regulations, and any permits up front, drawing on our pre-construction services—engineering, project management, right-of-way acquisition, and materials planning—to set a clear execution path. A dedicated project team is assigned and mobilized once the scope, schedule, and budget are aligned.
What happens after the project is completed?

Delivery isn’t where our commitment ends. Post-construction services include system relights, repairs, quality inspections, comprehensive as-built drawings, landscaping or hard-surface restoration, and even long-term Operations & Maintenance (O&M) support and electronic record-keeping. This ensures the asset performs safely and efficiently for years to come.
How do we handle unexpected challenges?

Whether it’s supply-chain delays on a 20 MWh battery-storage project or navigating protected wetlands for a 16-mile fiber install, our teams use detailed contingency planning, technology, and cross-disciplinary expertise to keep work moving safely and on schedule. A robust enterprise risk-management framework and field-level audits allow us to adapt quickly while maintaining safety and quality standards.
Can we handle complex projects?

Absolutely. With more than 9,600 employees, 13,000+ fleet assets, and operations across 46 U.S. states and six Canadian provinces, Centuri routinely delivers complex, utility-scale programs—from 500 kV transmission builds to miles of gas pipelines and compressor stations. Our size, modern equipment fleet, and integrated operating-company model give customers the reach of a national provider and the agility of a local partner.

pages.raw_title: Infrastructure and Utility Construction Capabilities | Centuri
pages.raw_meta: Discover Centuri’s utility infrastructure construction capabilities across electric, natural gas, renewable, underground, and emergency response projects.
raw_blocks: Energy & Utility Construction Capabilities

Centuri is a North American leader in utility construction, partnering with regulated utilities, energy providers, municipalities, and industrial operators to build and maintain the infrastructure and utilities that keep power, gas, and data flowing 24/7. With operating roots that stretch back 115 years and a workforce of 9,600 craft professionals supported by more than 13,000 fleet assets, we combine local agility with the resources of the #4 firm on Engineering-News Record’s Top-600 Utility list. Our purpose is simple yet ambitious: Connecting People to Power. We do so safely, reliably, and with an eye on the next generation of energy solutions.

Centuri’s holistic service portfolio supports our customers’ ever-increasing energy and infrastructure demands while surpassing today’s safety benchmarks. Our BLS Industry Comparison TRIR & DART safety scores outperform industry averages, demonstrating our commitment to the resources and training needed to achieve world-class safety.
Watch: Building the Next Century of What Powers North America

Centuri constructs and maintains every link of the modern utility grid, offering electric transmission, distribution, substation, and foundation services. We build and maintain overhead and underground transmission lines up to 500 kV. Recent projects include a 16-mile mountain-terrain transmission rebuild in the Rockies, a transmission line project in New Jersey that involved micropile foundations and substation upgrades, and the replacement of 445 wooden structures with steel monopoles using helicopter construction techniques.

Centuri installs and rehabilitates high-pressure transmission mains, distribution pipelines, regulator stations, and cathodic protection systems. Our construction capabilities include civil works, trenchless technologies, such as horizontal directional drilling (HDD), cross compression, and compressor stations. Recent projects include the installation of the 18-mile Kokomo Fusion steel pipeline, the replacement of a 30″ high-pressure pipeline across downtown Toronto, the replacement and installation of over 500 miles of main and replacement pipe for a natural gas utility customer, and a long-term partnership replacing aging high-pressure pipelines across Utah.
Distributed Power & Data Centers

Centuri delivers turnkey distributed power solutions— renewable natural gas (RNG) systems and pipelines, EV-charging infrastructure, and battery storage. Although the U.S. has a cumulative renewable energy capacity of 430GW, more expansion is needed to achieve net zero (BloombergNEF, 2024). We are helping utilities capture this opportunity. For example, Centuri installed the 20 MWh Andover BESS in New Jersey, sequencing work around supply-chain delays to hit the in-service date and boost peak resilience.

Centuri minimizes surface disruption while future-proofing communities, whether they use horizontal directional drilling (HDD) to install fiber or electric cables beneath major waterways or replace aging water mains. Our underground distribution capabilities won the NECA 2024 Project Excellence Award. Examples of recent projects include the installation of a nearly 2,000-feet deep sewer pipe at the Gary/Chicago Airport and the installation of 16 miles of fiber conduit for a Maryland data center.
Emergency Response & Storm Restoration

Extreme weather is the new normal, and utilities and municipalities need partners who can mobilize quickly. Centuri’s emergency response maintains real-time visibility of crews and equipment across 46 states and 6 Canadian provinces, allowing deployment within hours. We can immediately mobilize specialized crews and equipment to integrate rapid assessment with complete storm restoration. Centuri has participated in multiple storm response efforts, such as Hurricane Helene, which is a testament to our fast response ethos.
Local Agility, Resources to Scale

Plan & Survey: We obtain all necessary regulatory permits before project commencement. In design, we apply GIS-enabled route selection, digital twin modeling, and constructability reviews to mitigate cost and schedule risk.

Mobilize & Install: Crews mobilize our specialized equipment along with certified welders, linemen, and operators to self-perform the work , supported by either union or open-shop labor to match regional needs.
Test & Commission: New electrical systems tests, hydrostatic pressure tests, and SCADA platforms validate asset integrity before commissioning.
Restore: We restore sites to their original or improved condition through vegetation management, hydroseeding, and hard surface restoration.

Maintain: Post construction, we conduct inspection, quality checks, right-of-way maintenance, and overhead and underground maintenance for gas and electric assets, including substations and distribution lines.
Integrated Project Management & Technology

Centuri uses cloud-based platforms to unify schedules, costs, and field data. Engineers create AutoCAD models that integrate GIS mapping, then push approved designs into our cloud Customer Work Management Information System (WMIS). Field personnel capture as-built data, geotagged photos, and electronic permits, logging them into FOMS. Automated validations flag gaps, analytics optimize resources, while client dashboards enable same-day approvals. The result is fewer change orders, faster close-outs, and transparent collaboration with clients and regulators.

Centuri’s behavior-based safety programs and our BLS-based safety benchmarks ensure everyone goes home safely. Thousands of training hours and the use of certified technicians only reinforce our sustainable safety culture. Indeed, while the national TRIR benchmark stands at 2.4 (BLS, 2024), multiple Centuri projects had zero recordable incidents.
Scale & Stability: Coast-to-coast footprint, NYSE-listed (CTRI) public markets financial strength, and average customer relationships of 24 years.
Union / Non-Union Flexibility: Labor adaptability supports regional requirements without compromising craft quality.
Rapid Mobilization: Proven ability to marshal crews and asset fleets for storms, wildfires, and critical outages.
Innovation Leadership: Early adopter of LiDAR-enabled design and engineering, GIS-driven work packages, digital twins, and data analytics.
Energy-Transition Expertise: Our portfolio includes gigawatts of wind and solar projects, plus RNG and BESS successes.
Ready to Build the Future?

Centuri isn’t just another contractor; we’re a long-term strategic partner that helps you navigate a dynamic energy market. Contact our commercial sales team today to discuss partnership opportunities, project bids, or emergency preparedness plans. Let’s power the next century of safe, reliable, sustainable infrastructure and utilities together.
What types of utility construction projects does Centuri specialize in?
Our services span electric transmission and distribution, natural gas pipelines, RNG and BESS facilities, fiber and water networks, wind and solar, and complete emergency restoration.
How does Centuri ensure safety and quality on large-scale infrastructure projects?

Our unique behavior-based, scientifically proven initiatives, along with rigorous quality control checkpoints, third-party audits, and an industry-leading apprenticeship program keeps incident rates far below national averages.
What is Centuri’s experience with renewable energy construction services?
We have delivered numerous clean-energy infrastructure projects, including the 20 MWh Andover BESS, multiple RNG digester systems and pipelines, and the 0.5 MW, 2 MWh West Caldwell BESS project.
How quickly can Centuri mobilize for emergency restoration services?
Our national response center tracks crews and fleet 24/7 across 99 locations in 46 states and 6 Canadian provinces, enabling mobilization within 12 hours of an event.
What makes Centuri different from other energy infrastructure companies?
Scale, financial strength, union/non-union flexibility, digital workflows and project controls, demonstrated zero-incident performance, and a century-long legacy of client partnerships.
How does Centuri support utilities with large-scale infrastructure modernization projects?

We replace aging assets while improving reliability, capacity, and system control by implementing modernization projects such as gas pipe replacement, cathodic protection upgrades, compressor and regulator station overhauls, as well as electric grid hardening projects, including transmission line upgrades, hardened distribution feeder rebuilds, and power substation upgrades. Our industrial and utility-scale energy transition projects include BESS installations, data centers, and RNG plant construction. Among utility infrastructure construction companies, our value is end-to-end execution, including engineering and design support, materials management, self-performed construction, testing, and commissioning.
How does Centuri combine local crews with large-scale project resources across North America?

Centuri pairs local operating companies and crews with a North American footprint, including over 9,600 team members and more than 13,000 fleet assets. That gives customers field teams familiar with regional labor, permitting, and site conditions while still drawing on enterprise-scale workforce and equipment.
What technologies does Centuri use to improve utility construction project visibility and efficiency?

We deploy cloud-based platforms that unify schedules, costs, and field data, along with GIS-enabled route selection, AutoCAD models, digital twin modeling, WMIS, FOMS, geotagged photos, electronic permits, automated validations, analytics, and client dashboards.

Centuri uses cloud-based platforms to unify schedules, costs, and field data. Engineers create AutoCAD models that integrate GIS mapping, then push approved designs into our cloud Customer Work Management Information System (WMIS). Field personnel capture as-built data, geotagged photos, and electronic permits, logging them into FOMS. Automated validations flag gaps, analytics optimize resources, while client dashboards enable same-day approvals. The result is fewer change orders, faster close-outs, and transparent collaboration with clients and regulators.

Centuri’s behavior-based safety programs and our BLS-based safety benchmarks ensure everyone goes home safely. Thousands of training hours and the use of certified technicians only reinforce our sustainable safety culture. Indeed, while the national TRIR benchmark stands at 2.4 (BLS, 2024), multiple Centuri projects had zero recordable incidents.
Scale & Stability: Coast-to-coast footprint, NYSE-listed (CTRI) public markets financial strength, and average customer relationships of 24 years.
Union / Non-Union Flexibility: Labor adaptability supports regional requirements without compromising craft quality.
Rapid Mobilization: Proven ability to marshal crews and asset fleets for storms, wildfires, and critical outages.
Innovation Leadership: Early adopter of LiDAR-enabled design and engineering, GIS-driven work packages, digital twins, and data analytics.
Energy-Transition Expertise: Our portfolio includes gigawatts of wind and solar projects, plus RNG and BESS successes.

Centuri isn’t just another contractor; we’re a long-term strategic partner that helps you navigate a dynamic energy market. Contact our commercial sales team today to discuss partnership opportunities, project bids, or emergency preparedness plans. Let’s power the next century of safe, reliable, sustainable infrastructure and utilities together.
Our services span electric transmission and distribution, natural gas pipelines, RNG and BESS facilities, fiber and water networks, wind and solar, and complete emergency restoration.

Our unique behavior-based, scientifically proven initiatives, along with rigorous quality control checkpoints, third-party audits, and an industry-leading apprenticeship program keeps incident rates far below national averages.
We have delivered numerous clean-energy infrastructure projects, including the 20 MWh Andover BESS, multiple RNG digester systems and pipelines, and the 0.5 MW, 2 MWh West Caldwell BESS project.
Our national response center tracks crews and fleet 24/7 across multiple locations in 46 states and 6 Canadian provinces, enabling mobilization within 12 hours of an event.
Scale, financial strength, union/non-union flexibility, digital workflows and project controls, demonstrated zero-incident performance, and a century-long legacy of client partnerships.

We replace aging assets while improving reliability, capacity, and system control by implementing modernization projects such as gas pipe replacement, cathodic protection upgrades, compressor and regulator station overhauls, as well as electric grid hardening projects, including transmission line upgrades, hardened distribution feeder rebuilds, and power substation upgrades. Our industrial and utility-scale energy transition projects include BESS installations, data centers, and RNG plant construction. Among utility infrastructure construction companies, our value is end-to-end execution, including engineering and design support, materials management, self-performed construction, testing, and commissioning.
That gives customers field teams familiar with regional labor, permitting, and site conditions while still drawing on enterprise-scale workforce and equipment.

We deploy cloud-based platforms that unify schedules, costs, and field data, along with GIS-enabled route selection, AutoCAD models, digital twin modeling, WMIS, FOMS, geotagged photos, electronic permits, automated validations, analytics, and client dashboards.

pages.raw_title: About Centuri | Utility & Energy Infrastructure Partner for Electric and Natural Gas
pages.raw_meta: Centuri partners with regulated utilities to build and maintain electric and natural gas infrastructure—delivering safety-first execution and long-term value across North America.
raw_blocks: Through long-term partnerships, we help customers enhance the safety, reliability, and environmental sustainability of the electric and natural gas network consumers rely upon to meet their changing needs.

Centuri (SEN-chur-ee) is a strategic infrastructure services company that partners with regulated utilities and energy providers to help build and maintain the energy network that powers millions of homes and businesses across the United States and Canada. Guided by our values and our unwavering commitment to serve as long-term partners to customers and communities, Centuri’s more than 9,600 employees enable our customers to safely and reliably deliver electricity and natural gas and achieve their goals for environmental sustainability.
The Centuri Family of Companies

Our enterprise is founded on the idea of serving our markets for the long term. We call it the “100-year plan”, which is where we got our name. Our strategy for realizing that vision is embodied by our Think Ahead philosophy and the guiding principles of our Sustainability Framework. By adhering to these principles in everything we do, we ensure that we are well-positioned for lasting success.
Across the United States and Canada

Centuri successfully serves utility customers across the United States and Canada – in some areas for more than 100 years. Customers rely on our expertise to execute projects and meet stringent standards for safety, quality, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness. Through our work, Centuri has touched the lives of countless energy consumers while safely delivering utility infrastructure services .

We provide comprehensive service capabilities that cover the entire utility and infrastructure value chain. We have the opportunity for tremendous growth given our continued significant investment in utility infrastructure, 5G, and renewables.

As the energy transition accelerates, Centuri will be there to help customers meet a wide range of opportunities, from gas pipe replacement and hardening of electric distribution assets, to supporting infrastructure for offshore wind development and other clean energy advancements.

Centuri’s vision is to be the leader in safe, sustainable utility infrastructure services , while fulfilling our roles as a values-driven employer of choice and responsible corporate citizen in the communities where we live and work.
Because of our broad footprint, we are able to offer best-in-class solutions that align with our customers on safety and quality.

Centuri partners with utilities to build and maintain the energy network that powers millions of homes and businesses across the United States and Canada. Our integrated operating company model allows us to deliver tailored solutions to meet the distinct needs and workforce requirements of our customers, regardless of geography. Working together as one, we solve our clients’ most complex challenges.

We set the standard for environmental stewardship in the field, our fleet, and our facilities. Customers turn to Centuri to support and advance their goals for carbon neutrality, whether through system modernization and resiliency, or through the construction of renewable energy infrastructure.
